# Quickstart

Acme Hooks posts to your app when something happens. Install the CLI, sign in, create a hook.

## Install

```
npx -y https://acme.example/dl/acme-cli.tgz init
```

Then read [the install guide](https://acme.example/docs/install) and [how sign-in works](https://acme.example/docs/auth); pricing is at [pricing](https://acme.example/pricing).

## Call the API

```
curl -X POST https://acme.example/api/v1/hooks \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"hook":"orders"}'
```

```js
const response = await fetch("https://acme.example/api/v1/hooks", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.ACME_API_KEY}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ hook: "orders" }),
});
```

## Connect the MCP server

Add `https://acme.example/mcp` to your coding agent. The server lists your hooks and can create one.

Markdown twin: https://acme.example/docs/quickstart.md. Sign up at https://acme.example/signup.
